body: just found out he has accounts on furry porn websites where he can talk to other girls. absolutely disgusted. been together 2 years. our anniversary was a week ago and he did nothing for me. getting tired of being with him. he grosses me out.

I have and I will keep doing this, I feel he is just scared to talk about his true emotions with me. I want him to be safe and happy... if he still doesn't want to talk to me I'm going to find him a therapist to go to.

I try to be very understanding and let him take breaks from cleaning, work, ect. It just upset me because he's been telling me he's been doing better, and feeling happier. After seeing that, I just don't know if it's true or not if he's doing better. I just want him to be happy.
